notes: Customer: statewide emergency contact center modernization for critical incidents (flood, grid-outage, public safety).
Constraints: absolutely air-gapped environment for certain datastores; cannot route audio or transcripts off-prem. USB/sneakernet model updates are acceptable under HSM-based signing.

Primary ask: agent assist that surfaces relevant SOP steps and auto-fills case fields; ticket summarization for multi-channel incidents (voice, email, SMS); deterministic tool-calling to dialer and CRM (Avaya/Genesys/Custom Case DB).
Perf targets discussed: 95th pct < 250ms end-to-end for assist suggestions at 1k concurrent agents; sustained throughput 800 agents, burst to 2k during incidents.

requirements_summary: On-prem, air-gapped inference for contact center agent-assist + post-call summarization. Must integrate with Avaya/Genesys dialer and on-prem CRM. Strict audit trail for every model output and tool action. Deterministic QA: reduced hallucination tolerance, redaction for PII, versioned model artifacts with signed releases. Offline update mechanism (USB or secure staging host) and HSM/KMS for key signing.
tech_requirements: Real-time inference co-located with CTI stack (low-latency LAN)
STT integration (local) and ability to stream partial tokens to agent UI
Adapter SDK for Avaya/Genesys and internal ticketing API
Support for quantized models and fallback tiny-models for emergency mode
Comprehensive audit logs and immutable event store for regulators
poc_plan: Phase 1: Lab POC (2 weeks) - run private runtime in isolated rack; validate p95 latency < 250ms with synthetic agent load.
Phase 2: Air-gapped install (4 weeks) - deploy to staging datacenter with sealed update process; run real call samples (redacted) and verify tool-calls.
Phase 3: Pilot (8 weeks) - 200 agents live, measure accuracy of summaries and avg handle time reduction; test surge to 2k agents via replay tool.
Acceptance: security signoff + performance SLOs met + offline update SOP approved
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end assist latency p95 <= 300ms under normal load
Summarization F1 >= 0.78 on labeled incident prompts
Tool-calling success rate >= 99.5% across Avaya flows
Offline update process demonstrated with signed model artifact and HSM-backed key
Audit logs show immutable record for each model output and action (retention policy 7 years)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: air-gap update cadence slows patching - Mitigation: create signed incremental deltas + automation for staging verification.
Risk: hallucination on critical directives - Mitigation: constrained decoding + rule-based guardrails + human-in-loop confirmation for high-severity actions.
Risk: adapter certification for legacy PBX - Mitigation: embed binary shim and provide on-site integration support; include certification window in SOW.
commercial_notes: Customer prefers annual committed Dedicated or Private licensing. Procurement requested ELA template; pricing sensitivity around right-sizing reserved capacity for bursts.
